purpose: Painterly Thessaly arena; game sprite/background establish her identity, approved Ashmaw painting establishes style and composition.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide 2:1 painterly fantasy live raid arena backdrop for Thessaly, the Plague Warden. Original new artwork.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing game sprite of Thessaly: use its hooded blue-black robed, pale spectral female warden silhouette as character identity, NOT its pixel medium. Image 2 is her existing game environment: ruined stone courtyard, violet storm sky, sickly green plague fog. Image 3 is the APPROVED Ashmaw arena: match its restrained painting style, broad grouped shapes, implied detail, atmospheric depth and usable arena composition. Do NOT include Ashmaw or volcanic lava.
Scene: an ancient abandoned plague ward courtyard, broken uneven stone flagstones and low ruined arches, on a windswept misty moor. Wide open quiet playable ground fills the lower half. A few large crumbling wall masses frame the sides, softened into distance. A faint broken circular ward in the stone leads toward a raised ruined dais on the upper-right. Low sickly grey-green mist collects between the paving slabs and around the perimeter. Above, broad rolling charcoal and muted purple storm clouds, with soft spectral violet illumination behind Thessaly. No visible lightning bolts baked into the painting.
Subject: Thessaly is the dominant looming threat on the right third, roughly x .70 y .32, her hood and upper torso visible above the dais, her base merging into green mist. An ancient female plague warden with a long heavy blue-black hood and tattered robes, a pale shadowed face barely suggested beneath the hood, two small sickly green eye accents, long gaunt hands held apart as if keeping a curse alive. Her pose is grounded and immovable, robes merging into a dark grouped silhouette. Imposing and frightening, not a pin-up or human hero portrait. Her robe should be a few broad draped planes, not a thousand tiny folds. A simple crooked warding staff may stand at her right with a single dim green lantern-shaped magical core. No giant wings, horns, dragon, tentacles or excessive ornaments. Body proportions coherent. Keep her face around x .71 y .25 with room above it for sky.
Composition: original 2:1 horizontal wide arena; a low camera across varied weathered stone and modest uneven cracks/ridges. Keep the upper-left quiet for native raid UI and lower central foreground clear for the game's party. No painted raiders, heroes, soldiers, skeleton minions or other people. Thessaly must read unmistakably at small display sizes, occupying approximately a quarter to a third of the image width. Her dark robe silhouette separates from the pale fog and violet sky. Leave plentiful broad dark ground; do not fill everything with scenery.
Style: hand-painted fantasy illustration, economical confident visible brush strokes, suggested forms, lost-and-found edges, soft atmospheric perspective. Same level of restraint as the approved Ashmaw painting. A few grouped stones and arches; details suggested, never individually explained. No photoreal microtexture, gloss, 3D renders, etched ornament, repetitive scales, high-frequency noise, intricate filigree or over-sharpening. Quiet large shapes and one sinister focal point.
Palette: charcoal slate, muted blue-black robes, desaturated moss green plague mist, soft spectral violet sky; sparse pale green eye and staff accents. Avoid bright neon everywhere. No orange lava, red fire or warm volcanic palette.
Constraints: no text, interface, border, watermark or labels. No raiders. Only Thessaly in the scene. Make a finished evocative, intimidating arena composition that can be animated with moving fog and clouds over stable painted ground and a stable boss silhouette.
